response.rationale: R2 is the directly supported canonical diagnosis using two calcification sites. C1 is a dependent append-only completion of R2 and adds only the longus colli anatomy already contained in R2's shared CT span; after discounting that correlated restatement, C1 provides no independent diagnostic advantage.

rejected.why: Dependent append-only completion of R2; its added longus colli anatomy is already supplied by the same raw CT span supporting R2.
